deep_analysis:
Flat book: 0 open trades, so no per-trade regime/stop/staleness steers are actionable this cycle — all enforced open-trade checks are vacuous. The real work is on the closed side.

We are on the right side when we SHORT and the wrong side when we LONG. Last 24h: SHORT 8/13 (62%) +0.31, LONG 3/9 (33%) -0.24, net +0.07 on 22 closes. Last 7d: SHORT n39 +0.57 (46%), LONG n82 -1.73 (38%). Every dollar the system has lost this week came from the long side, yet we still take 2x more longs than shorts (82 vs 39) — the signal mix is long-heavy while the tape is bearish. The winning side was the short side all week; we keep showing up late on the long side.

Long failure pattern is concentrated and repeatable: pump-chain+ LONG 7d n13 8% WR -0.89 (its own short twin pump-chain-/pump-chain-v6- is +0.31 over n9 — same logic inverted, and the inverted side is the one that pays), ai-trader-pending LONG 0/7 -0.16, ai-trader+ LONG n6 33% -0.27, bb-bounce-v2-long+ n17 47% -0.58. 24h long losses: GRASS LONG rsi 60.8, PUMP LONG 65.3, WLFI LONG 57.1 (hard_max_loss), ME LONG 74.7 (trail_arm_timeout) — three of four entered at RSI >=57 in a falling tape.

meta_rsi band read (7d, verified from _signal_metadata, NOT entry_rsi_14): LONG 45-60 = n42 36% WR -1.63 — the band we call the sweet spot is this week's biggest bleed; LONG >=70 = n10 70% +0.49 (longing strength works, mid-band longs are chop entries). SHORT 45-55 dead zone n8 25% -0.18; SHORT >=55 n9 56% +0.64. Implication: in this tape, entries near band edges with momentum win; center-of-band "balanced" entries lose.

Exit anatomy confirms the trend rule: 7d hard_max_loss 14 trades 0% WR -1.79 and atr_sl_hit 29 trades 0% -1.63 are chop entries dying before trail can arm, while profit-monster-trail 36 trades 89% +2.08 and rr_engine_trail_hit 80% +0.54 carry all the profit. We win by catching trends; we lose by entering during chop.

Data-integrity flag on the automated engine: steer-001 claims a 'volume-buildup- 4-loss streak, net -0.04 over last 20'. PostgreSQL disagrees — the 4 losses (#16363-#16367) all closed 11:46-14:54 on 10-23 and were followed by 5 straight wins (WLD, ICP, DYDX, MON, SYRUP, 15:16-22:53); 7d n12 net +0.01, 24h n10 60% WR. The streak condition has reversed; do not disable this signal on the strength of that steer.

RETRACTIONS (prior cycle 2026-10-23 23:21 steers, re-tested against DB at write time): both positions those steers keyed on have closed, so neither condition steer stands. CFX SHORT #16373 hold-steer — MOOT, trade closed +0.34 (trail win; EMA300-reclaim exit condition never fired). BTC SHORT #16377 invalidation-steer (81180 SL / EMA300 reclaim 15-30m thesis-dead) — MOOT, trade closed -0.08 via manual_sl_hit; entry side lost to the tape as flagged (precheck advisory FAIL: LOSERS list, death-zone meta_rsi 47.6). No open positions remain, so no prior steer is being re-issued this cycle.
regime_context:
Sources disagree — naming each: 5m aggregate scanner (01:00) = SHORT_BIAS (9 long / 46 short / 66 neutral); BTC 15m regime = SHORT_BIAS (conf 57.1, slope -0.041); BTC 4h regime = LONG_BIAS; continuum = BELOW EMA300 (BTC 1m price ~80730 vs EMA300 ~81071, -0.42%, below for 860+ consecutive minutes since 17:38 yesterday); BTC 1m linreg_direction = LEAN_BEAR (trend_quality field has been flipping to UP intraday); auto-trader regime = CHOP with score long -55 / short +15 at price 80750. Portfolio vol: LOW, volume LOW, wyckoff DISTRIBUTION.

Flip-rate KPI: aggregate 29 flips/24h, BTC 15m 17 flips/24h (96 dumps). 29 >= p95 (26) = UNUSUALLY UNSTABLE tape this cycle; baseline is ~20-22, and <6 (real trend tape) has not occurred since Oct 2. Direction-flavored guidance must therefore stay condition-locked, not asserted: shorts are favored WHILE BTC 1m holds below EMA300 (re-check each cycle — if 1m closes reclaim and hold EMA300 ~81071 for 15-30m, the short bias steer expires and flips). Auto-trader BRACKET order is the correct shape for this chop (short trigger 80522 / long trigger 81537 both armed, 120min old).

Net: the tape is a leaning-but-unstable bear. Align new risk SHORT-side, keep position count low (0/6 open), and treat any long idea as needing stronger evidence (RSI >=70 momentum, not mid-band) until the continuum reclaims EMA300.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED in PostgreSQL (brain), 24h = 22 closed / 7d = 121 closed, all RSI from (_signal_metadata::json->>'rsi_14') per DRIFT-E.

1. LONG side bleed — 7d LONG n82 net -1.73 WR 38% vs SHORT n39 net +0.57 WR 46% (24h: LONG -0.24/33%, SHORT +0.31/62%). WINNING SIDE: short. WHY WE WEREN'T ON IT: signal mix generates 2x more longs than shorts regardless of tape direction — we are not choosing the side, the signal inventory is.

2. pump-chain+ LONG — 7d n13, 8% WR, -0.89. Its inverse pump-chain-/v6- SHORT: n9, +0.31. WINNING SIDE: the short of the same setup. WHY: pump-chain+ fires on pumps that are bear-trend bounces; in a below-EMA300 tape the pump gets sold. Most expensive single signal in the book.

3. Chop entries, not bad exits — 7d exit_reason: hard_max_loss n14 0% -1.79, atr_sl_hit n29 0% -1.63 vs profit-monster-trail n36 89% +2.08, rr_engine_trail_hit n5 80% +0.54. WINNING SIDE: anyone already in the trend before we entered. WHY: we enter mid-chop, never reach +0.40% to arm trail (52/56 historical hard_max_loss trades never armed), die at the stop.

4. Center-band entries lose this week — LONG meta_rsi 45-60: n42 36% WR -1.63 (worst bucket) while LONG >=70: n10 70% +0.49; SHORT 45-55: n8 25% -0.18 while SHORT >=55: n9 56% +0.64. WINNING SIDE: momentum-at-the-edge entries. WHY: mid-band = no edge in a trending tape; the 'pick RSI 45-60' heuristic is a chop heuristic and this is not a chop tape (it is unstable-bear). n is modest — treat as directional, not law.

5. ai-trader-pending LONG — 7d n7 0% WR -0.16 (ai-trader+ LONG n6 33% -0.27). WINNING SIDE: the short leg of the same BTC context. The pending-order path is entering longs into an EMA300-below tape.

6. RECONCILED: automated steer-001 (volume-buildup- 4-loss streak) is stale — those 4 losses closed 11:46-14:54 Oct 23 and were followed by 5 consecutive wins through 22:53; signal is currently 24h 60% WR and 7d +0.01. Condition reversed; disabling it now would strand our best recent short signal.
